name: Jared
overview: Jared, also called Jered, is a significant patriarch in the genealogical line from Seth, as recorded in Genesis 5, where he is noted as the son of Mahalaleel and the father of Enoch. He lived 962 years, highlighting the longevity of early biblical figures. Jared's place in the genealogy is further emphasized in Luke 3:37, which traces the ancestry of Jesus Christ through him, underscoring Jared's role as an ancestor of our Lord and Savior.
